items.description: Roll one extra die for the roll's main dice item and keep the better ones (higher, or lower when the roll step says `better: low`).
Roll one extra die for the main dice item and keep the worse ones.
Remove advantage: once the advantage and disadvantage sources are counted, the advantage count is 0, the player's situational advantage included. Disadvantage is left alone.
Remove disadvantage: once the sources are counted, the disadvantage count is 0. Advantage is left alone.
Reroll dice showing `below` or less (once per die when `once` is true). With `count`, at most that many dice are rerolled, lowest faces first (earliest first among equal faces).

Multiply the dice count of every dice item in the roll, including items added by other effects (5E's critical hits), except items marked `multiplied: false` (added by an effect, or from a roll part, with `multiplied: false`).

Multiply the value of every item of the roll once it is rolled, dice and flat alike: after rolling and before the roll's bounds, each item's value is multiplied by every counted factor in turn, an integer result rounded by the effect's `rounding`, else `settings.rounding`. Items marked `multiplied: false` are left alone. Faces are unchanged; the item records `factor`. Stacking applies by stack key (orc-2e's and MÖRK BORG's critical hits double the damage).
Dice showing `at` or more (default: the highest face) roll again and add.
Add `count` dice of the pool's die type to a dice part (default: the step's first), before its keep/drop modifiers. Each added die records its source.

Change the size of the dice from the roll's own parts: each die moves `steps` along d4, d6, d8, d10, d12 (negative for smaller), stopping at either end; other sizes are left alone. With a `parts` target, only the matching parts' dice. The counted modifiers' steps add up; they stack by key, compared by `steps`. The item records `steppedFrom`.

Give a dice item its first faces instead of rolling them: the roll's main dice item, or with a `parts` target the first dice item of a matching part. Extra dice (advantage, rerolls, explosions) are still asked for. Each given face is marked `set: true`; of several counted modifiers on one item, the first in effect order applies.
